verdict.rationale: TaxJar ships a specific background automation: AutoFile handles state return filing and remittance autonomously and migrates state reports into returns without manual work. It also continuously tracks economic nexus thresholds, and it pulls data from marketplace and commerce integrations. These are fixed, vendor-defined automations, not user-configurable automations an AI-native user can set up to run in the background. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automation or workflow builder, scheduling or trigger configuration, webhooks or event hooks, agent-facing automation tooling, independent corroboration that AutoFile and nexus tracking work as claimed.
